description: The Uber aggregate selection gen/pfb_agg_types (ADR-11; issue #4038, sub-slice 9h). A case's stored value is what config.xml holds (absent when the case has none); php is today's reader, pfb_global()'s $pfb['agg_types'] (the types of PFB_AGGREGATE_TYPES the stored CSV names, in that constant's order); aggregates is what the settings adapter answers in policy/ip: the same types, each as its lower-case class, a derived field the Outpost answers and ignores on a write. A refused row is a value Core refuses to read.

cases.description: The IP page with nothing selected stores an empty CSV.
Every type selected, as the IP page stores them.
A hand-edited order: the reader keeps the constant's order.
A type named twice is selected once.
Hostile: an unknown type and empty tokens are ignored.
Hostile: the reader compares case-sensitively, so a lower-case type selects nothing.
Hostile: a token with a leading space selects nothing; the others stand.

refused.description: Core holds the class in lower case.
A string where the list belongs.
A string where an item belongs.
